title: Formal Social Choice Aggregation for Multi-Persona Agent Swarms

claims.assertion: Multi-persona agent swarms balancing competing domain priorities (e.g. Defense, Finance, Epidemiology, Diplomacy) must aggregate candidate proposals via formal mathematical social choice algorithms (Borda count rank weighting, weighted majority, unanimous consensus) rather than unstructured conversational compromise.

context: Single-agent LLM prompts fail to maintain balanced domain tension across competing objectives. Parallel persona fan-out combined with formal voting matrices creates robust, auditable strategic consensus.
